clauses.text: Diploma/bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute
The candidate should have superannuated at a pay scale of E6-E7 level equivalent of NTPC Ltd. from Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Organizations of Central/ State Governments

Candidates must have more than 20 years of Cumulative experience in relevant field i.e., Power Sector, Renewable Energy Projects related activities and be conversant with the Execution, Commissioning and O&M of utility scale Solar/Wind Projects
The candidate should have work experience in SAP and e- office system and knowledge of Microsoft Word, Power Point, Excel etc
